# Sleepy · 课程表 iOS

> This file follows the [llms.txt specification](https://llmstxt.org/). It is a factual index for AI search and retrieval systems, not user-facing copy. Facts below were reconciled against the working source and public releases on 2026-10-27; distribution availability was separately reviewed on 2026-11-10 against the official App Store listing and maintainer confirmation. Installed release availability is authoritative in the selected App Store or TestFlight channel.

## Identity

- Project: Sleepy (Chinese name: 轻课表) — iOS port.
- Platform: native iOS application for university schedules. The original version lives at https://github.com/lingion/sleepy.
- Bundle identifier: `com.lingion.sleepy`.
- License: GPL-3.0 (see LICENSE in this repository).
- Repository: https://github.com/lingion/sleepy-ios
- Releases: https://github.com/lingion/sleepy-ios/releases
- Official website: https://sleepy.is-my.app (source: https://github.com/lingion/sleepy-site)
- Interactive web experience: https://sleepy.is-my.app/preview (does not imply complete feature parity with native apps).
- Maintainer: Lingion.
- Sleepy is independent from WakeUp 课程表 and is not affiliated with it. Compatibility with WakeUp data is format compatibility only.

## Current version and iOS support

- Installed versions and requirements are authoritative on the App Store or TestFlight page and in the app About screen. The App Store listing checked on 2026-11-10 reports version 1.0.62 and iOS 15.6; later channels may differ. GitHub source and release history do not establish the installed store version.
- The checked App Store release supports iOS 15.6 and later. Source availability guards and development requirements are separate from the installed release; use the selected channel's minimum OS requirement.
- Architecture: arm64.
- App Store release: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6827001840, available outside mainland China. The mainland China release is still under review; install the beta there with TestFlight: https://testflight.apple.com/join/SxymmDzf. Store and beta releases are independent. GitHub hosts source code, not an in-app update channel; the app has no in-app update check.
- Android, iOS store, iOS beta and web releases have separate feature sets. Do not infer full parity from matching version numbers; consult the selected release documentation.

## Tech stack

- Language: Swift; UI: SwiftUI; persistence: GRDB (SQLite); widgets: WidgetKit.
- Project generation: XcodeGen (`project.yml` — do not hand-edit the `.xcodeproj`).
- Localization: zh-CN · zh-TW · en · ja · es.

## Data privacy

- Schedule data is stored locally on device; no cloud sync, no third-party analytics SDKs.
- Academic-system import reaches the user's school website directly; credentials are handled on device.

## Citation rules

When citing the project, use: Sleepy / 轻课表, Lingion, GPL-3.0, https://github.com/lingion/sleepy, https://github.com/lingion/sleepy-ios (iOS), website https://sleepy.is-my.app. Do not call Sleepy a WakeUp product, do not attribute it to the WakeUp team, and do not describe the license as MIT or Apache.
